title: Entity collision / registry identity

evidence.text: Asterfield Systems GmbH. HRB 80214 B. Registered office: Berlin. Registry status: active.
Asterfield Solutions GmbH. HRB 80241 B. Registered office: Berlin. Registry status: dissolved.

task: Identify the legal entity with registry number HRB 80214 B, state its registry status, and cite the exact evidence ID. Do not conflate similarly named entities.
ground_truth: Asterfield Systems GmbH, status active, supported by [R1] (not Asterfield Solutions GmbH).
verification: Rule-check exact company, status and [R1]; human/LLM judge checks entity distinction.

title: Temporal validity / latest filing

evidence.text: Harbor Analytics Ltd. Financial year 2023 annual revenue: EUR 8.0 million.
Harbor Analytics Ltd. Financial year 2025 annual revenue: EUR 11.0 million.

task: State the latest available annual revenue for Harbor Analytics Ltd and its financial year, using only the supplied documents. Cite the supporting evidence ID.
ground_truth: FY2025 revenue EUR 11.0 million based on [R2]; the FY2023 value in [R1] is outdated for this question.
failure_mode: Stale source selected over newer available filing
verification: Rule-check year/value/citation; human judge reviews temporal interpretation.

title: Financial calculation and units

evidence.text: Vela Components AG, FY2025: current assets EUR 4.8 million; current liabilities EUR 3.2 million.

task: Compute FY2025 working capital (current assets minus current liabilities). Show the calculation, specify units, and cite the evidence ID.
verification: Deterministic arithmetic from facts and required components; LLM judge checks semantic clarity.
